description: Source implementation for the DTV (Digital TV) plugin, managing DVB tuner and service operations such as initialization, service searches, playback, and event handling within a digital TV framework.

classes.name: DTVImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing Digital TV services, including initialization, service searching, playback control, and event notification within the framework.

classes.name: LnbImpl
classes.description: Implementation of LNB (Low Noise Block) satellite dish configuration and control.

classes.name: SatelliteImpl
classes.description: Implementation class representing satellite information and operations.

classes.name: ServiceImpl
classes.description: Represents a digital TV service with methods to access service details.

classes.name: ComponentImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for service components (e.g., streams).

classes.name: TransportImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for transport stream information.

classes.name: EitEventImpl
classes.description: Implementation for EIT (Event Information Table) event data.

classes.name: EitExtendedEventImpl
classes.description: Implementation for extended EIT event data.

classes.name: StatusImpl
classes.description: Implementation for status information of a service or tuner path.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes DVB system and configures country settings based on provided framework configuration.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for search and service events notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetNumberOfCountries
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of supported countries.

methods.name: GetCountryList
methods.description: Gets a list of available country configurations.

methods.name: GetCountry
methods.description: Gets the currently selected country code.

methods.name: SetCountry
methods.description: Sets the currently active country code.

methods.name: GetLnbList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of configured LNB satellite tuner settings.

methods.name: GetSatelliteList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of configured satellite sources.

methods.name: GetNumberOfServices
methods.description: Returns the count of available services.

methods.name: GetServiceList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available digital TV services.

methods.name: GetServiceInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed information for a specific service identified by its IDs.

methods.name: StartServiceSearch
methods.description: Starts searching for services based on tuner type and search parameters.

methods.name: StartPlaying
methods.description: Begins playback of a service specified by a DVB URI.

methods.name: StopPlaying
methods.description: Stops the ongoing playback of a service.

methods.name: DvbEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback function that handles DVB events and dispatches notifications.
